resources.string: Readly reads aloud with Kokoro, a natural-sounding voice that runs entirely on your phone. It needs a one-time 103 MB download. After that, reading works offline and nothing you read leaves your device.
Starts the one-time download. Afterwards reading works offline.
Stops the download. Nothing is installed until it finishes.
To read something, open any app, tap Share, and choose Readly. Round 2 adds the reader.
